actualPrompt:
Use case: background-extraction. LOCAL CONTACT / RECEIVER LUMINANCE MASK, STEP S2.
Image 1 is the ONLY input: full 1536x1024 UMIRI source scene with local contact/receiver regions deliberately painted WHITE in S1. Preserve EXACT EXISTING WHITE MARK LOCATIONS, contours and softness. Do not draw/reinterpret a new shadow or shift it.
Keep ONLY those deliberate local contact marks WHITE: real compressed cushion immediately under hips/skirt and supporting palm, mainly x890..1280,y550..635; real local boot-sole/floor darkness separately beneath the two boots, mainly x828..1110,y855..945. These guides are limits, NOT boxes or geometry to draw. Keep actual irregular cushion/palm contact bands and separate original shoe-floor marks where already painted. Do not enlarge, connect distant regions, move cushion marks onto lap, or move floor marks up onto shoe uppers. Thin source-edge gray antialias may remain.
EVERYTHING ELSE becomes pure BLACK, including the ENTIRE girl/hair/face/eyes/hands, ALL clothing and both complete shoes. Her naturally light shirt/skin/socks/shoe caps are NOT deliberate S marks and must be BLACK. Natural white curtain, clouds, lamp shade, ceramic cup, flower petals, linen cushion, plaid-pillow light stripes, knitted throw and sunlit floor/rug must also become BLACK. Black room everywhere except the deliberately marked local receiver groups; no window sun lattice or broad room patch.
Output ONE opaque complete 1536x1024 black PNG with only the unchanged original-position contact/receiver selections white. No colored scene, new body, new shadow, transparency, boxes, grid, labels, arrows or text.
representation: F/S union is fixed original-source joint subject with included local receiver material; not portable caster or new RGB figure.
producerObservations: Personally viewed black-background white receiver mask; it retains seat/palm band and separate rounded shoe-floor receiver regions. No claim that this is a clean portable cast shadow.
